description: Translate the remaining narrative-prose CJK across the repo and run the final audit. After FEAT-006 the audit shows 16 files with narrative-prose CJK lines still to translate (most are 2026-03 plans + findings/progress + a handful of FEAT-006 stragglers + 5 skill front-matter cases). Plus 25 files have CJK only inside fenced code blocks or inline backtick code spans (legitimate verbatim per rule D) and are allowed to retain it. This feature finishes the prose translations, audits the repo, and commits the audit summary.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-translate-md-ptbr/translation-rules.md AND .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/translation-rules-cn.md before editing.

Re-run the audit: `python3 .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/cjk-audit.py > /tmp/cjk-audit.txt 2>&1 || true; cat /tmp/cjk-audit.txt`. NOTE: the script reads from /tmp/cjk-current.txt, so first regenerate that with `find . -name '*.md' -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.agents/*' -not -path './.pytest_cache/*' -not -path './tests/knowledge/fixtures/*' -exec grep -l -P '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' {} \; | sort > /tmp/cjk-current.txt`.

Translate the prose CJK in the following docs/plans/2026-03-*, findings.md, and progress.md files. Preserve fenced code blocks, identifiers, paths, citation URLs, the **Verdict: APPROVE** / **Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES** literals where they exist, and emoji.

- docs/plans/2026-03-04-autonomous-agent-loop.md (1 prose CJK line at line 218: a checklist item starting `- [x] 回归测试通过 | \`...\``. Translate the Chinese label `回归测试通过` to PT-BR, e.g. `testes de regressao passam`. Keep the inline backtick command verbatim.)

- docs/plans/2026-03-04-kiro-code-intelligence-integration.md (8 prose CJK lines around 48-50 etc.: checklist items like `- [x] code-analysis.md 包含 initialize_workspace 指令 | \`grep -q '...'\``. Translate the Chinese narrative text after the file name; keep the file/identifier names and inline commands verbatim.)

- docs/plans/2026-03-04-ov-auto-sync-recall.md (32 prose CJK lines starting at line 1: `# OV 自动落库与召回强化`. Translate title, Objetivo, Nao-Objetivos, all section bodies. Keep fenced code blocks, command samples, identifier names, file paths verbatim.)
- docs/plans/2026-03-04-ov-auto-sync-recall.progress.md (1 prose line at line 5: `**Tarefa:** session-init 启动时自动启动 OV daemon...`. Translate the Chinese tail to PT-BR.)
- docs/plans/2026-03-04-reasoning-loop-coarse-checklist.md (1 prose CJK line at line 84: `- [x] 回归测试通过 | \`python3 -m pytest...\``. Same pattern as autonomous-agent-loop.)

- docs/plans/2026-03-31-evaluator.md (4 prose lines at 12, 13, 22 etc.: short Chinese inserts inside English/PT-BR sentences like `(未写的代码)`, `(已写的代码)`, `(anti-走过场)`. Translate each Chinese gloss to PT-BR keeping the surrounding text. e.g. `(codigo nao escrito)`, `(codigo ja escrito)`, `(anti-formalidade)` or natural rephrasing.)

- docs/plans/findings.md (51 prose lines starting around line 69 with `### 核心发现`. Translate every Chinese narrative paragraph. Keep citation refs like `Anthropic 论文` -> `paper da Anthropic`, technical terms in English, fenced code blocks verbatim.)

- docs/plans/progress.md (5 prose lines at 236, 461-462, etc. - Chinese tails inside otherwise PT-BR sentences. Translate each Chinese clause to PT-BR keeping the surrounding text and the leading `Task N:` markers.)

Also translate the 3 FEAT-006-straggler files where the CJK is in narrative test-spec lines (NOT in fenced code blocks). These are checklist items quoting example user inputs in double quotes. The double-quoted user-input strings ARE pattern-matched literals (the hooks must match these exact strings), so PRESERVE them verbatim. Translate ONLY the surrounding prose.

- docs/plans/2026-02-14-v3-cleanup-and-hardening.md lines 196-201: `- [x] context-enrichment.sh casa "这不是我想要的效果"` etc. The `casa` and `nao dispara para` parts are already PT-BR. The Chinese is INSIDE the double-quoted string literal that is the hook input. KEEP the quoted Chinese strings verbatim - those are the test-anchored input strings the hooks must match. NO CHANGES needed for this file - move on.

- docs/plans/2026-02-18-claude-code-compatibility.md lines 152, 154: `9. context-enrichment research detect: prompt with "调研一下 X" -> verify ...` etc. Same pattern: the Chinese inside double quotes is the literal user-input string the hook must match. KEEP the quoted Chinese strings verbatim. NO CHANGES needed for this file.

- docs/plans/2026-02-19-knowledge-auto-evolution.md lines 30, 53: `... grep for action words (禁止/必须/never/always)`. The `禁止/必须` are the actual regex grep patterns that distill.sh greps for in episodes (per hooks/_lib/distill.sh:53). KEEP these verbatim - they document the regex pattern. NO CHANGES needed for this file. Also note line 53 has `"禁止"` again as a test assertion pattern.

Skip the 5 skill front-matter files entirely (omk-coding, omk-pdf-gen, omk-skill-creation, omk-stitch, omk-youtube). Per rule C, the YAML front-matter `description:` and `triggers:` values are matched at runtime by hooks/feedback/context-enrichment.sh, so the embedded Chinese trigger keywords are PATTERN-MATCHED LITERALS that MUST remain unchanged. NO edits to these files in this feature.

After all translations are committed, regenerate the audit: `find . -name '*.md' -type f -not -path './.git/*' -not -path './.agents/*' -not -path './.pytest_cache/*' -not -path './tests/knowledge/fixtures/*' -exec grep -l -P '[\x{4e00}-\x{9fff}]' {} \; | sort > /tmp/cjk-final.txt && python3 .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/cjk-audit.py > /tmp/cjk-audit-final.txt`. The audit must show: 0 files with prose CJK (excluding the carve-out group below) AND a count of files with only-in-fence/inline CJK that includes the expected legitimate cases.

Verify all 9 test-anchored literals one last time across the whole tree: `for lit in 'Coding agent' 'GTM' 'Evidence before claims' 'Skill Routing' 'Authority Matrix' 'episodes.md' 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' '**Verdict: APPROVE**' '**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**'; do count=$(grep -r -F -l "$lit" --include='*.md' . 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); echo "$count files: $lit"; done`. Each count must be >= 1.

Verify no NEWLY-introduced em dashes in translated lines: `git diff main HEAD -- '*.md' | grep '^+' | grep -v '^+++' | grep -F -- '—'` should ideally be empty; if non-empty, each remaining + line containing an em dash must be a round-trip preservation (the same em dash character also appears on a `-` line in the diff). Spot-check by sampling 5 such lines.
Run the full verification suite: pytest with the documented ignore set, `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh`, `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh`. ALL counts must match baseline exactly.

Write a final audit summary to .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/audit.md listing: total files translated in this CN -> PT-BR pass, the carve-out groups (in-fence demo files, in-front-matter pattern-matched literals, in-quote test-input literals, in-code regex pattern literals), confirmation of the 9 test-anchored literals, baseline test counts.

Stage and commit the docs translations with message: `docs(i18n): translate 2026-03 plans + findings + progress CN -> pt-BR`. Then commit the .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/audit.md with message: `docs(i18n): final audit of CN -> PT-BR translation pass`. Use `git add -f` for paths under `.agents/`.
acceptance_criteria: Every docs/plans/2026-03-*.md, findings.md, progress.md file has zero PROSE CJK (CJK inside fenced code blocks or inline backtick spans is allowed per rule D).

Final audit grep across the repo (excluding .git, .agents, .pytest_cache, tests/knowledge/fixtures) returns at most ~30 files; ALL of those files must have CJK only inside (a) fenced code blocks, (b) inline backtick code spans, (c) YAML front-matter description:/triggers: values, (d) double-quoted test-input literals quoted in checklist/test-spec lines, or (e) regex pattern literals quoted in design narrative.
Zero NEWLY-introduced em dashes in any newly-translated prose line.

All 9 test-anchored English literals (Coding agent, GTM, Evidence before claims, Skill Routing, Authority Matrix, episodes.md, BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES, **Verdict: APPROVE**, **Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**) appear at least once in the repo after this pass.
Baseline test counts unchanged: pytest 60p/8f, agents-template 27p/1f, knowledge 1/3.
.agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/audit.md exists and lists the final state with category counts.
verification: Run `python3 .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/cjk-audit.py` and confirm the 'narrative-prose CJK' group lists ONLY: skills/omk-coding/SKILL.md, skills/omk-pdf-gen/SKILL.md, skills/omk-skill-creation/SKILL.md, skills/omk-stitch/SKILL.md, skills/omk-youtube/SKILL.md (front-matter pattern-matched literals), docs/plans/2026-02-14-v3-cleanup-and-hardening.md (test-input literals in double quotes), docs/plans/2026-02-18-claude-code-compatibility.md (test-input literals), docs/plans/2026-02-19-knowledge-auto-evolution.md (regex pattern literals).

Run `for lit in 'Coding agent' 'GTM' 'Evidence before claims' 'Skill Routing' 'Authority Matrix' 'episodes.md' 'BEGIN OMK PRINCIPLES' '**Verdict: APPROVE**' '**Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES**'; do n=$(grep -r -F -l "$lit" --include='*.md' . 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$n" -ge 1 ] || echo MISSING_AFTER_PASS: $lit; done` - prints nothing.
Run pytest with the documented ignore set - tail must contain `8 failed, 60 passed`.
Run `bash tests/test-agents-template.sh` - must end with `Results: 27 passed, 1 failed`.
Run `bash tests/knowledge/run.sh 2>&1 | tail -10` - must contain `Scripts: 1 pass / 3 total`.
Confirm .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/audit.md exists and lists the final state.
findings: Translated 8 docs files (autonomous-agent-loop, kiro-code-intelligence-integration, ov-auto-sync-recall + .progress, reasoning-loop-coarse-checklist, 2026-03-31-evaluator, findings.md, progress.md). Final audit shows 0 prose-CJK files outside the 8 documented carve-outs (5 skill front-matter pattern literals + 3 test-data plans with quoted user-input/regex-pattern literals). All 9 test-anchored English literals present. Baseline test counts unchanged (pytest 60p/8f, agents-template 27p/1f, knowledge 1/3). No new em dashes outside backtick code spans. Audit summary at .agents/tasks/task-translate-cn-ptbr/audit.md.
